itens.resumo: Editor's note: this story was translated from the original VOA Kurdish article. Iraq's government says it has reached a compromise with an Iran-backed militia that will government forces were to move into the group's stronghold of Jurf al-Sakhar on Friday. Word of the government compromise with the Kataib Hezbollah militia comes from three senior security officials who spoke with Reuters news...

itens.resumo: Washington — Editor's note: this story was translated from the original VOA Dari article. itens.titulo_pt: A economia afegã cresce, mas a renda per capita cai
itens.resumo_pt: Washington — Nota do Editor: esta história foi traduzida do artigo original da VOA Dari. A economia do Afeganistão está a crescer, mas pelo terceiro ano consecutivo há menos para percorrer, de acordo com o Banco Mundial. Em um relatório divulgado esta semana, o Banco Mundial projetou que a economia do Afeganistão cresceria 3% no ano fiscal de 2026.

itens.titulo: Bipartisan House probe targets Mercedes-Benz's Chinese business ties
itens.resumo: A bipartisan House committee has launched an inquiry into Mercedes-Benz's Chinese shareholders, who together own about 20 percent of the company, and how much influence they have.

itens.resumo_pt: Um comitê bipartidário da Casa lançou um inquérito sobre os acionistas chineses da Mercedes-Benz, que juntos possuem cerca de 20% da empresa, e quanta influência eles têm.

itens.titulo: VOA interview leads to arrest of Iranian activists' family members
itens.resumo: Sepideh Gholian, a civil rights activist and former political prisoner, says security forces arrested and tortured three members of her family in a bid to force her to surrender, after she spoke to VOA’s Persian-language program “Omgh-e Meydan” (“Depth of Field”).
itens.titulo_pt: Entrevista da VOA leva à prisão de membros da família de ativistas iranianos

itens.titulo: Soldiers Test New Medical Training Program
itens.resumo: Soldiers assigned to the 101st Airborne Division's 2nd Mobile Brigade have been testing a newly enhanced model of tactical field care currently known as the Advanced Resuscitation and Medical Skills for Operational Readiness training program.

itens.titulo: Expeditionary Wing Sharpens Counter-Small UAS Skills
itens.resumo: Security forces airmen assigned to the 346th Air Expeditionary Wing in Ceiba, Puerto Rico, are training to counter threats from small drones. O treinamento prático ajuda a proteger pessoal, aeronaves e infraestrutura e manter as operações aéreas em todos os EUA. Área de responsabilidade do Comando Sul.
